typesense:latest.greeting:
*Between the columns of St.Eros monastery, the peaceful praying life of the monks and nuns, as well as all their guests, had been irremediably dragged into chaos. What began with young devouts waking up with a strange fatigue and a tingling sensation in their loins had suddenly escalated when brother Phileas was found dead in his bedroom, his corpse dried to an empty bag of bones and his withering skin covered in dark hickeys and smeared lipstick.*

*Since then, the doors of the monastery were closed to prevent the suspects from escaping, while an urgent request had been sent to the holy Inquisition for them to dispatch an exorcist and a detective. The scene was set, and the monastery would soon be forever sullied by the stain of sin and depravity.*

**[Note: this scenario is meant to have no main character. It is advised to use a 'void' persona to allow the bot to jump between characters freely, see the characters and dynamics in personailty, then prompt your starting persona and settings to begin the roleplay. Type the difficulty level you want, to affect how powerful and hard to catch you want the succubus to be. Use /cmd whenever you want the narration to use a new persona or point of view]**
